title: π–π stacking assisted regioselectivity regulation in palladium-catalyzed cyclization reactions: a theoretical study
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38285-38292
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06552B, Paper
Open Access

Song Liu, Dianmin Zhang, Yue Gong, Lianli Ma, Li Li, Wei Chen
Manipulating the structural differences in the reaction substrates leads to the formation of distinct products. Computational evidence that supported a π–π stacking assisted regioselectivity regulatory mechanism was presented.
